Alternatives to Trader Joe's 100% Colombian Instant Coffee? (Including a suggestion of my own)
As we all know from this sub, Trader Joe's 100% Colombian Instant Coffee has disappeared from shelves because of supply chain issues.

![img](54e4wn4hjsx91 "Goodbye, old friend. :(")

Have you found alternatives yet?

Here's what I'm drinking now:

(Note: This is not from TJ's, unfortunately, but you can probably find it locally or online.)

![img](gtnv5s3sjsx91 "Yaucono Instant Coffee")

Just to be clear, it doesn't taste like Trader Joe's 100% Colombian Instant Coffee. But it also doesn't taste like most other instant coffees: bitter, cheap, gas station swill. It's tasty and smooth as silk. If I had to blind taste test it, I wouldn't know it was instant. (Again, this is not from TJ's, but you can probably find it locally or online.)

What are you drinking now that TJ's 100% Colombian Instant Coffee has disappeared?
